name: New-pool price-discovery acceptance
hypothesis: Buy after prices align with existing executable references and a subsequent independent-demand breakout occurs.
spec: Setup: A newly created pool can broaden discovery once early anomalous prints pass. Entry: Buy after prices align with existing executable references and a subsequent independent-demand breakout occurs. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on renewed misalignment or failed breakout. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs synchronized multi-pool DEX quotes (not connected)
